name: integration-eventbus-callbacks-wave15-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture uses a synthetic local platform event and deterministic ChangeEventHeader values; it proves callback overload and header behavior locally without claiming hosted event delivery.

evidence.notes: Callback overload returns a successful local SaveResult for an EventUuid-bearing platform event.
List callback overload returns ordered successful local SaveResult values.
ChangeEventHeader is constructed and inspected in anonymous execution.

args: Widget_Event__e event = (Widget_Event__e)Widget_Event__e.SObjectType.newSObject(null, true); Database.SaveResult one = EventBus.publish(event, null); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> many = EventBus.publish(new List<SObject>{event}, null); System.assertEquals(1, many.size()); System.assert(many[0].isSuccess()); eventbus.ChangeEventHeader header = new eventbus.ChangeEventHeader(); header.changedfields = new List<String>{'Name'}; header.setChangeOrigin('wave15'); header.setChangeType('UPDATE'); header.setCommitNumber(42L); header.setCommitTimestamp(1700000000123L); header.setCommitUser('005000000000001AAA'); header.setDiffFields(new List<String>{'Description'}); header.setEntityName('Account'); header.setNulledFields(new List<String>{'Phone'}); header.setRecordIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA'}); System.assertEquals('Name', header.changedfields[0]); System.assertEquals(true, header.equals(header)); System.assertEquals('wave15', header.getChangeOrigin()); System.assertEquals('UPDATE', header.getChangeType()); System.assertEquals('Name', header.getChangedFields()[0]); System.assertEquals(42L, header.getCommitNumber()); System.assertEquals(1700000000123L, header.getCommitTimestamp()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001AAA', header.getCommitUser()); System.assertEquals('Description', header.getDiffFields()[0]); System.assertEquals('Account', header.getEntityName()); System.assertEquals('Phone', header.getNulledFields()[0]); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', header.getRecordIds()[0]);
